0022600164.text: The Dallas Mavericks, 4-2 and riding a three-game winning streak, host the winless Sacramento Kings, who are 0-6 and have lost six straight, with the Mavericks sitting 6th in the West and the Kings 15th. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Kyrie Irving is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while Zach LaVine is day-to-day with an elbow injury and also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 Dallas lost the season series 1-2, including a 130-121 home loss to Sacramento on February 26.
